description: This file defines the interface for a hardware device communication module, providing external functions for reading from and writing to a device, as well as preparing responses.

methods.name: HDK_Device_Read
methods.description: Reads data from the device into a buffer

methods.name: HDK_Device_PrepareWrite
methods.description: Prepares the output stream for writing a response

methods.name: HDK_Device_Write
methods.description: Writes data to the device from a buffer
